items.title: Go heap allocations become enforceable
items.oneliner: Go analyzer flags hidden heap allocations across a function call tree and ships fixed-size data structures for zero-alloc paths.

items.title: Symbolic regression runs in seconds
items.oneliner: Single-binary symbolic regression tool extracts equations from CSV data and returns deterministic formulas with r2 scores.

items.title: A free cross-platform DAW is emerging
items.oneliner: Open-source FL Studio-inspired DAW already includes piano roll, playlist, mixer, and built-in plugins on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

items.title: A RISC-V CPU lives inside Qwen
items.oneliner: This repo demonstrates a deterministic RISC-V CPU embedded in Qwen weights that can execute C and MicroPython.

items.title: GNU Guix for embedded reproducibility
items.oneliner: Hands-on walkthrough shows how Guix makes embedded builds reproducible while shipping a procedural sound application.

items.title: C CPU feature detection gets practical
items.oneliner: Concrete guide maps compiler macros for Arm and x86 so you can ship optimized C code with safe fallbacks.

items.title: Go interfaces and heap costs explained
items.oneliner: This video shows when empty interfaces trigger heap allocations and how escape analysis changes Go performance.

items.title: If-then-else gets a sharp history
items.oneliner: A compact markdown essay traces how conditional logic evolved from ENIAC wiring to modern programming syntax.

items.title: H.264 compression becomes intuitive
items.oneliner: Clear technical explainer shows why H.264 makes video thousands of times smaller while preserving useful visual detail.

items.title: Permutation parity finally clicks
items.oneliner: This math video connects puzzle solvability, Rubik's Cube moves, and determinants through permutation parity.
